decisions.reason: Selecting C94598 for the passive buzzer does not change the battery connector family, part number, pin functions, or unresolved pin order.
The accepted C94598 part is for the passive buzzer, not the independently selected LED daughterboard components.
The buzzer part selection does not alter the selected ESP32-S3 module or its LCSC part number.
The source acceptance resolves only the passive buzzer part and does not change the addressable LED part, supply, power control, or data interface.
The passive buzzer selection has no necessary effect on the battery-charge status display or dedicated charge-LED circuit.
The source decision selects a buzzer component and does not modify any interboard connector, pinout, or power-distribution rule.
Although C94598 may later appear in manufacturing artifacts, the source only approves the buzzer part and does not explicitly or necessarily modify the existing power-board BOM-readiness state.
The passive buzzer part selection does not affect USB enumeration, flashing, connector sourcing, or USB data routing.
The selected buzzer part is unrelated to the SPS30 connector, power supply, and I2C-mode signal assignments.
